site.title: Lico's Archive
site.tagline: my little corner of the internet. games, experiments, and other stuff i made to learn things.
about: hi, i'm Lico! welcome to my archive.
this is where i keep the games and experiments i make for fun. each one started with a question i wanted to figure out. once i figured it out, it's done.
some are finished, some are prototypes, some are parked because they already taught me what i wanted. all of them are a little dumb. that's fine.
play stuff right here in the browser or grab a download. no ads, no tracking, no accounts. oh, and Dave lives at the bottom. he's tired. be nice.

games.title: Dodge Box
games.question: How fast can difficulty ramp before it stops feeling fair?
games.learned: Spawn rate and fall speed both scaling with time felt brutal. Ramping only one of them at once felt fair for much longer.
games.description: Move a green square. Don't get hit by yellow ones. That's it.
games.controls: Arrow keys or A/D to move. Drag on touch screens. Space or tap to start.

games.title: Bounce Lab
games.question: How much does restitution change how a bounce feels?
games.learned: Below 0.5 things feel heavy and dead. Above 0.9 they feel like rubber toys. 0.8 reads as 'normal ball' to most people.
games.description: A physics toy. Tap to drop balls and change how bouncy the world is.
games.controls: Tap or click to drop. 1, 2, 3 change bounciness. G toggles gravity. C clears.

games.title: Desktop Build Slot
games.question: What does a download-only entry look like here?
games.learned: Entries without a 'play' field show a download panel instead of a game window.
games.description: A placeholder for a Windows, Mac or Linux build you want people to download.
